objects.description: One thing a person did to an agency, put on record: who did it, what they did, what it was done to, and when. Append-only: an entry is never edited or removed.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: instance_id
fields.description: The agency the action was taken in. Every listing is narrowed to one of these, so one agency never reads another's log.

fields.name: actor
fields.description: Who acted, exactly as they authenticated.

fields.name: action
fields.description: What they did, in plain words such as "renamed the agency".

fields.name: subject
fields.description: What the action was done to, in plain words or as an id. Empty when the action had no single target.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it happened, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC. The only ordering a log has.

indexes.name: instance
indexes.description: Reading one agency's log, newest first.
